title: limonium vulgare subsp. angustifolium
intro: Limonium vulgare subsp. angustifolium, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a plant species within the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Limonium vulgare subsp. angustifolium, but it has been traditionally used to treat skin conditions and promote wound healing.
